entities.name: RNA polymerase omega subunit
observations: The 134-aa query sequence exactly matches reviewed Rhizobium etli/Rhizobium leguminosarum RNA polymerase omega-subunit sequences.
Reference annotation: promotes RNA polymerase assembly by latching N- and C-terminal regions of the beta-prime subunit, facilitating interactions with beta and alpha subunits.
Associated process annotation: DNA-templated transcription. The retrieved reference annotations did not specify subcellular localization.
